records.title: ICT Market Structure Notes
records.snippet: A bullish fair value gap forms after bullish displacement. Entry is considered on the retracement into the gap during the New York session when higher-timeframe bias remains bullish. Invalidation is a candle-body close below the gap low.

records.title: Liquidity Sweep Continuation Lesson
records.snippet: After sell-side liquidity is swept and price reclaims the level with a bullish body close, look for continuation into an imbalance or fair value gap. Risk is defined beyond the sweep extreme.
